theorems.name: Submission.cmcdtfr_boundary_variation
theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) S.support → S ω = 0) → ∀ (P m : ℕ) (s : Finset ((Fin (m + 1) → Fin P) × (Fin P → ℤ))) (u : (Fin (m + 1) → Fin P) × (Fin P → ℤ) → Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ) (Q₀ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), (∀ p ∈ s, StrictMono p.1) → (∀ p ∈ s, IntegrableOn (u p) {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), Q₀ ω = ∑ p ∈ s, ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, u p y * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ))) → Q₀.boundary.mass < ∞ → ∃ V : (Fin (m + 1) → Fin P) × (Fin P → ℤ) → ℝ, (∀ p ∈ s, 0 ≤ V p) ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (∑ p ∈ s, V p) ≤ Q₀.boundary.mass ∧ (∀ p ∈ s, ∀ g : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} → (∀ y, ‖g y‖ ≤ 1) → ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, u p y * LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) (fderiv ℝ g y) ≤ V p) ∧ (∀ p ∈ s, V p ≠ 0 → ∃ y : Euclid (m + 1), (∀ i, 0 ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ 1) ∧ (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) ∈ Q₀.boundary.support)
